# Contributing

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CONTRIBUTING.vi.md)

Thank you for helping make the Qwen3.8-27B TPU showcase easier to reproduce and learn from.

The complete community contribution guide is [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). It covers suggested improvements, CPU tests, TPU evidence requirements, bilingual documentation and safe handling of model inputs.

A good pull request explains **the benefit to readers**, includes commands and observed results, and never misrepresents CPU mocks as TPU inference.
